parole.significato: An apparatus; an instrument; a device.
parole.testo: From German Apparat and Russian аппара́т (apparát). Doublet of apparatus.
From gastro- + critic, a calque of German Gastrokritiker and Russian гастрокритик (gastrokritik).

parole.significato: A health resort, especially one in a German-speaking country or in the area of the former Soviet Union.
parole.testo: Borrowed from German Kurort, in some cases via Russian куро́рт (kurórt).

parole.testo: Via German Mazurka and Russian мазу́рка (mazúrka), from Polish mazurek (“dance of the Masurian”), the Masurians being the inhabitants of Mazowsze (compare Medieval Latin Mazovia), an ancient cultural region in east-central Poland.
From photo- + apparatus, a calque of Czech and Slovak fotoaparát, German Photoapparat, Russian фотоаппара́т (fotoapparát), etc.

parole.testo: From German Sastruga, from Russian заструга (zastruga).
Back-formation from sastrugi, by treating it as a pseudo-Classical plural, from German Sastrugi, from Russian заструги (zastrugi).

Borrowed from German Schamane, from Russian шама́н (šamán), from Evenki шама̄н (şamān), сама̄н (samān), from Proto-Tungusic *samān. The Evenki word is possibly derived from the root ша- (şa-, “to know”); or else a loanword from Tocharian B ṣamāne (“monk”) or Chinese 沙門 /沙门 (shāmén, “Buddhist monk”),
Calque of German Sozialfaschismus and/or Russian социал-фашизм (social-fašizm), terms that gained currency during the Weimar years.
